house.description: Transitional housing renovation and construction funding provided, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Human Services Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for transitional housing renovation and construction.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; TRANSITIONAL HOUSING RENOVATION AND CONSTRUCTION. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for grants to eligible recipients under Minnesota Statutes, section 256K.48. The eligible recipients must use the grant funds to: (1) renovate existing facilities not currently operating as transitional housing sites into transitional housing sites; (2) renovate existing transitional housing sites; (3) construct new transitional housing sites; or (4) improve the safety, sanitation, accessibility, and habitability of existing transitional housing sites. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
